const inferred = { fail(): never { throw new Error("missing"); } };
function useInferred(value?: number) {
  if (value === undefined) inferred.fail();
  return value.toFixed();
}
class Stop {
  fail(): never { throw new Error("missing"); }
}
const stopper = new Stop();
function useInferredInstance(value?: number) {
  if (value === undefined) stopper.fail();
  return value.toFixed();
}
function optionalCallback(stop?: () => never): number {
  stop?.();
}
function optionalProperty(obj: { fail?: () => never }) {
  let result: number;
  obj.fail?.();
  return result;
}
function optionalReceiver(obj?: { fail(): never }): number {
  obj?.fail();
}
